title: Repair with personal gold
detail: Repairs at merchants using your gold, up to the cap (default 10g). /fs cap 25 changes it. Hold Shift to skip.

title: Sell junk at merchants
detail: Uses the game's Sell All Junk operation, including items YOU marked as junk. Hold Shift to skip. No custom selling rules yet.

title: Faster automatic looting
detail: Loots slots when the client opens loot in auto-loot mode. Holds off in combat or while Shift is held. Keeps confirmations intact.

title: Accept offered quests
detail: Accepts a quest when its details open. Hold Shift to read normally. Quest exceptions and filters are planned for a later stage.

title: Turn in quests without reward choices
detail: Completes quests with zero reward choices and no money requirement. Multiple or single choice rewards remain manual. Hold Shift to skip.

title: Maximum stack size
detail: Adds maximum stack size to stackable item tooltips outside combat.

title: Item level in tooltips
detail: Adds the actual item level for equipment outside combat. Bag and character overlays are a later stage.

title: Item ID in tooltips
detail: Adds the item ID outside combat. Re-hover after changing tooltip options.

title: Auto-loot by default
detail: Enables the client's auto-loot setting. Your prior value is restored when switched off, unless another tool changed it.

title: Cast on key press
detail: Activates action buttons on key press instead of release. Your prior value is restored when switched off, unless another tool changed it.

title: Disable full-screen glow
detail: Disables the full-screen glow effect when this CVar exists. Your prior value is restored when switched off, unless another tool changed it.

title: Always show enemy nameplates
detail: Keeps enabled enemy nameplates visible outside combat. Your prior value is restored when switched off, unless another tool changed it.

title: Disable low-health screen flash
detail: Disables the red screen flash at low health. Your prior value is restored when switched off, unless another tool changed it.

title: Instant quest text
detail: Shows quest text immediately when supported by the client. Your prior value is restored when switched off, unless another tool changed it.

title: Stack nameplates vertically
detail: Uses the client's stacking layout for nameplates. Your prior value is restored when switched off, unless another tool changed it.

title: Class colors on enemy nameplates
detail: Uses class colors for supported player nameplates. Your prior value is restored when switched off, unless another tool changed it.

title: Hide friendly pet nameplates
detail: Hides pet plates without hiding friendly players. Your prior value is restored when switched off, unless another tool changed it.

title: Hide friendly guardian nameplates
detail: Reduces nameplate clutter from friendly guardians. Your prior value is restored when switched off, unless another tool changed it.

title: Hide friendly totem nameplates
detail: Hides friendly totem plates. Your prior value is restored when switched off, unless another tool changed it.

title: Hide enemy pet nameplates
detail: Hides enemy pet plates; enemy player plates keep their own setting. Your prior value is restored when switched off, unless another tool changed it.

title: Show enemy totem nameplates
detail: Enables nameplates for enemy totems. Your prior value is restored when switched off, unless another tool changed it.

title: Always show personal resource bar
detail: Keeps the enabled personal resource display visible outside combat. Your prior value is restored when switched off, unless another tool changed it.

title: Show target of target
detail: Enables the client's target-of-target display. Your prior value is restored when switched off, unless another tool changed it.

title: Hide your overhead name
detail: Removes your character's own overhead name. Your prior value is restored when switched off, unless another tool changed it.

title: Hide player titles
detail: Hides titles in overhead player names. Your prior value is restored when switched off, unless another tool changed it.

title: Hide overhead guild names
detail: Hides guild names above player characters. Your prior value is restored when switched off, unless another tool changed it.

title: Hide overhead guild ranks
detail: Hides guild ranks above player characters. Your prior value is restored when switched off, unless another tool changed it.

title: Hide critter names
detail: Hides overhead names on noncombat creatures. Your prior value is restored when switched off, unless another tool changed it.

title: Disable camera bobbing
detail: Disables the client camera's bobbing setting. Your prior value is restored when switched off, unless another tool changed it.

title: Disable camera terrain tilt
detail: Disables automatic terrain tilt when the CVar exists. Your prior value is restored when switched off, unless another tool changed it.

title: Disable camera water collision
detail: Allows the camera to cross the water surface. Your prior value is restored when switched off, unless another tool changed it.

title: Enable chat mouse-wheel scrolling
detail: Enables chat scrolling with the mouse wheel when supported. Your prior value is restored when switched off, unless another tool changed it.

title: Do not auto-open loot history
detail: Keeps loot history from opening automatically. Your prior value is restored when switched off, unless another tool changed it.

title: Hide spell activation overlays
detail: Hides the client's on-screen spell activation artwork. Your prior value is restored when switched off, unless another tool changed it.

title: Keep chat text visible
detail: Disables fading on existing chat windows. Restores their previous fading setting when switched off.

title: Arrow keys edit chat
detail: Lets arrow keys move the text cursor without holding Alt. Restores each edit box when switched off.

title: Drag Blizzard windows
detail: Shift-drag common client windows to a new place. Sizes, tabs and buttons are unchanged; drag is disabled in combat.

title: Resize and scale windows
detail: Resize a window with a corner grip or /fs size <window> <width> <height>; sizes are saved with the layout.

title: Remember window positions
status: implemented-preview as an option of FS-037; in-game validation pending
detail: Saved per window in ForeverSuiteDB.layouts and restored when the window opens, including after a reload. Configured by the Remember positions option of FS-037.

title: Per-layout window profiles
detail: /fs layout save|use|delete <name> stores every moved window position and size as one named set.

title: Reset a single window
status: implemented-preview as a command; in-game validation pending
detail: Use /fs windows reset <WindowName> to clear one saved window position and put that window back to where it was when the feature was first enabled. /fs windows list prints the managed names.

title: Snap windows to screen bounds
detail: Keeps dragged windows inside the screen bounds with a configurable margin, including after a resolution change.

title: Window anchor relationships
detail: /fs anchor <window> <target> [x] [y] pins one window to another and follows it when it opens.

title: Keep compatible panels open together
detail: Reopens the panels the client closes when another opens, and leaves a panel alone once its own close button was used.

title: Panel exceptions for secure or fragile frames
detail: Excludes auction house, world map and protected frames from every ForeverSuite window feature.

title: Keyboard accept/continue
detail: Press Space, Enter or E to click the visible Accept or Continue button. Never completes a quest with reward choices, ignores popups, passes the key through when no button is available, and pauses in combat or while Shift is held.

title: Keyboard numbered gossip selection
detail: Number keys 1 to 9 choose the matching gossip option while a gossip dialog is open. Options that cost money are never chosen. Nothing is accepted or turned in by this feature.

title: Keyboard reward selection
detail: Number keys 1-6 click the matching quest reward icon. Selection never turns in the quest; the client confirmation button is still required.

title: Custom dialog key bindings
detail: Binds turn-in and decline to their own keys and keeps the accept key separate, all disabled by default.

title: Dialog click priority
detail: Buttons named with /fs watch are tried before the standard quest buttons, so a server-specific frame can take priority.

title: Dialog popup exclusions
detail: Static popups, gossip, trainer and bonus-roll frames are never clicked. Only the visible accept/continue buttons and explicitly watched buttons are used.

title: Custom watched buttons
detail: Extra buttons can be watched with /fs watch <ButtonName>; the dialog key presses the first visible and enabled one, and /fs watch clear removes them.

title: Dialog key hints
status: implemented-preview as an option of FS-046; in-game validation pending
detail: Optional key hint above the button the dialog key would press. Configured in the Keyboard accept and continue feature options.

title: Selective beta survey suppression
detail: Hides beta survey and feedback popups by frame name, with a list in /fs popups.

title: Restore manual beta reporting
detail: /fs bugreport opens manual reporting even while the reporter button is hidden.

title: Hide beta reporter button independently
detail: Hides the beta reporter button independently of the survey suppression option.

title: Bag item-level overlays
detail: Shows actual item levels on bag slots with position and size options. Numbering only; no item is moved, sold or sorted.

title: Bank item-level overlays
status: implemented-preview as an option of FS-057; in-game validation pending
detail: Enable Include bank on the bag item-level feature to number main bank slots and bank bags. Bank contents are only known after the bank has been opened.

title: Character item-level overlays
detail: Shows actual item levels on equipped character-panel slots with position and size options. Inspect, bag and bank overlays are separate features; loot and flyout overlays remain planned.

title: Inspect item-level overlays
detail: Shows actual item levels on the inspected player equipment after inspect data arrives. No extra inspect request; GUID-checked to avoid stale data.

title: Loot item-level overlays
detail: Item levels on the loot window and on need/greed roll frames, so the decision can be made before the roll timer ends. Nothing is looted or rolled automatically.

title: Equipment flyout item levels
detail: Item levels in the equipment flyout and shopping tooltips.

title: Average equipped item level
detail: Shows the client average equipped item level on the character panel. An option adds the overall average, which includes carried items.

title: Missing enchant indicators
detail: Marks equipped items that have an empty enchant slot.

title: Missing gem indicators
detail: Marks equipped items with empty gem sockets.

title: Socket inspection helpers
detail: Summarises sockets and gems in a tooltip line, with /fs sockets for the full list.

title: Upgrade arrows
detail: Compares the hovered equippable item with the equipped item in that slot and states the item level difference. Rings, trinkets and two-hand weapons compare against the best matching slot. An option hides downgrades. Nothing is equipped or sold.

title: Bind-type labels
detail: States how the item binds, from the client bind type value.

title: Durability overlays
detail: Shows remaining durability as a colored percentage in each character-panel slot. Items without durability show nothing.

title: Equipment label positioning
detail: Text position and size are options on every item-level overlay feature, including bag and bank slots.

title: Tooltip class colors
detail: Colours unit tooltip names by class for players and by reaction for NPCs.

title: Tooltip health bar
detail: Adds current and maximum health plus a percentage to unit tooltips.

title: Tooltip borders and colors
detail: Border colour choice (gold, blue, green or red) for the game, item and shopping tooltips, restored on disable.

title: Tooltip anchor modes
detail: Pins the game tooltip to a fixed corner or lets the client place it.

title: Tooltip combat visibility rules
detail: Hides open tooltips when combat starts so they cannot cover the fight.

title: Spell IDs in tooltips
detail: Adds the spell ID to spell tooltips outside combat when the client labels the tooltip as a spell.

title: NPC IDs in tooltips
detail: Adds the NPC ID for creature and vehicle tooltips outside combat, parsed from the standard GUID. Player, pet and game-object tooltips are left alone.

title: Quest IDs in tooltips
detail: Adds the quest ID to quest tooltips outside combat where the client exposes that tooltip data type.

title: Currency IDs in tooltips
detail: Adds the currency ID to currency tooltips outside combat when the client labels the tooltip as currency.

title: Item counts by storage location
detail: Adds the owned count from bags, with an option to include bank contents. Does not count other characters or accounts.

title: Reputation token details
detail: Adds the faction and amount to items whose own tooltip text grants reputation.

title: Quest-starting item details
detail: Marks an item that starts a quest and shows the quest name when the tooltip text has it.

title: Guild repair funds policy
status: implemented-preview as an option of FS-001; in-game validation pending
detail: Repair funding option: personal gold, guild bank only, or personal then guild. Guild funding is used only when the client allows guild repairs; the repair cap still applies.

title: Repair feedback and totals
status: implemented-preview as an option of FS-001; in-game validation pending
detail: Prints the amount paid after an automatic repair. Guild repairs report the same way. Turn the option off to keep chat quiet.

title: Never-sell item list
detail: Items on the never-sell list are always kept, by item ID. Manage it with /fs neversell add|remove|clear.

title: Sell whitelist
detail: Item IDs on the whitelist are sold even above the quality or item level limit; quest items, recipes and never-sell items stay protected.

title: Sell by quality and item level
detail: Sell at or below a chosen quality and optionally below a maximum item level.

title: Sell by binding and expansion
detail: Optional bind filter that limits sales to bind-on-equip items.

title: Custom junk marking
detail: Mark and unmark bag items as junk with /fs junk and /fs unjunk. The client bulk sale then includes them.

title: Buyback-aware sale batches
detail: Items per merchant visit are capped at 12, the client buyback slot count, so a mistake is always reversible.

title: Sale preview and cancellation
detail: A preview window lists every candidate and waits for confirmation before anything is sold.

title: Quest acceptance exceptions
detail: Quests listed by ID or exact title are skipped by the keyboard accept and turn-in keys; /fs quest except and /fs quest allow manage the list.

title: Quest completion exceptions
detail: Quests named on the never-turn-in list stay open. Manage it with /fs except turnin.

title: Daily/weekly quest filters
status: implemented-preview as options of FS-004; in-game validation pending
detail: Quest acceptance can skip daily and repeatable quests independently. Weekly quest filters and named exceptions remain planned.

title: Trivial quest filters
detail: Prints one notice when a quest is trivial for your level, using the client quest level and green range.

title: Already-completed quest filters
detail: Optional skip for quests the client already reports as completed.

title: Single-option gossip rules
detail: Option to choose a lone gossip option automatically, never when it costs money.

title: NPC-specific gossip preferences
detail: A remembered gossip option per NPC is chosen again when that window opens; money options are never chosen.

title: Paid gossip exclusions
detail: Money gossip options are never selected by key or by the lone-option rule.

title: Flight map shortcuts
detail: Lists taxi nodes with /fs taxi list and takes one by number with /fs taxi <n>; never picks a destination automatically.

title: Friend and guild invite acceptance
detail: Accepts party invites from friends and guild members only, with an optional chat note.

title: Block stranger invites
detail: Declines group invites from players who are not friends or guild members. Both allowances are options, and a chat line reports each decline unless turned off. Shift or combat lets the invite through.

title: Duel decline rules
detail: Declines duels by stranger rule or level gap, with friends and guild exempt by default.

title: Summon acceptance rules
detail: Confirms a running summon from the group, or from friends and guild only, outside combat and without Shift.

title: Resurrection acceptance rules
detail: Accepts a resurrection offer only while dead, out of combat, and from the trust level you choose.

title: Battleground release rules
detail: Releases the spirit after death inside battlegrounds and arenas after a chosen delay.

title: Whisper invite rules
detail: Invites players who whisper a chosen keyword, limited to friends and guild unless anyone is allowed.

title: Opt-in loot trade confirmation
detail: Lists the items on your side of a trade with item levels; never accepts or alters the trade.

title: Opt-in crafting confirmation
detail: Prints the selected recipe and its reagents when the recipe or create button changes.

title: Opt-in destruction text helper
detail: Requires the word confirm for /fs reset, /fs profile delete and /fs chatlog clear.

title: Chat font sizes
detail: Changes chat window font size without changing the font itself. The previous size is restored when the feature is switched off.

title: Chat edit box placement
detail: Places the chat input line above the chat frame as an option.

title: Chat button visibility
detail: Hides the chat menu and scroll buttons. Chat, typing and mouse-wheel scrolling keep working.

title: Sticky chat controls
detail: Keeps the chat menu and scroll buttons at full opacity instead of letting them fade.

title: Chat history length
detail: Raises how many lines each chat window keeps for scrollback, from 128 to 2048. The previous limit is restored when the feature is switched off.

title: Copy chat text
detail: Keeps the last 200 chat lines in memory and opens them in the selectable copy box with /fs copy [lines].

title: Whisper notification sounds
detail: Plays a chosen built-in sound for incoming whispers and can flash the chat tab through the client's own alert.

title: Persistent chat history
detail: Keeps the last 200 chat lines in saved settings and prints them with /fs chatlog.

title: Chat channel management
detail: Joins saved custom channels again after login and manages the set with /fs channels add, remove and list.

title: Whisper conversation window
detail: A small conversation window shows the stored whispers with one player and sends replies through /fs reply.

title: Class-colored chat names
detail: Colours sender names in say, yell, party, raid, guild and whisper lines by class using the guid the chat event provides.

title: Chat message filtering
detail: Hides chat lines that contain a listed word or phrase across the main channels with /fs filter add, remove and list.

title: Context-menu website links
detail: The client exposes no supported way to add entries to the chat link context menu without replacing the secure menu, which would taint chat. Only a full replacement is possible, and ForeverSuite avoids that, so this is not shipped.

title: Chat frame unclamping
detail: Removes the screen-edge clamp from chat windows so they can be dragged partly off screen. The previous clamp is restored on disable.

title: World-map coordinates
detail: /fs where prints the map coordinates under the cursor; the readout only reads the open world map.

title: Cursor map coordinates
detail: A coordinate label on the world map follows the mouse while the map is open.

title: Zone level ranges
detail: Prints the classic level range of each zone on entry and with /fs zone; unknown zones stay silent.

title: Dungeon entrance markers
detail: Lists entrance coordinates and level ranges for 18 classic dungeons and can set the client user waypoint there.

title: Dungeon floor maps and legends
detail: Dungeon floor maps and per-floor legends need map art and floor data the Forever client does not expose to addons; a hand-drawn replacement would be inaccurate, so this is not shipped.

title: Unexplored-area reveal and tint
detail: Revealing or tinting unexplored areas requires the client's fog-of-war data, which is not readable by addons on this client; the feature would either do nothing or guess, so it is not shipped.

title: Waypoint commands
detail: /fs way <x> <y> [mapID] sets the client's own user waypoint and /fs way clear removes it.

title: Teleport favorites
detail: Saves named spell IDs and casts them with /fs tele <name>; nothing is bought or learned.

title: Teleport menu
detail: A small clickable panel of saved teleport favorites, opened with /fs tele menu.

title: Travel integration with external route planners
detail: External route planners need web access, which addons cannot use; ForeverSuite never opens external connections, so route planning beyond the client's own map is not offered.

title: Flight time display
detail: Tracks and prints how long the current taxi flight has taken.

title: Quest-level labels
detail: /fs quests lists every logged quest with its level and difficulty colour.

title: Quest tracker distance sorting
detail: Adds distance to the quest listing and sorts it by distance when the client reports it.

title: Quest item keybinding
detail: /fs useq <name|itemID> uses one matching quest item from your bags outside combat.

title: Quest target keybinding
detail: /fs qtarget <name> targets a creature by name without attacking or interacting.

title: Questie tooltip integration
detail: Questie already draws its own tooltip data; duplicating it would fight that addon's display, so ForeverSuite reads no Questie internals and this integration is not shipped.

title: Quest-start item markers
detail: Whether an item starts a quest is not reported by the client item API; a hand-maintained quest database would go stale, so item quest-start markers are not shipped.

title: Camp benefit tooltips
detail: /fs rested reports rested experience and its share of a level.

title: Camp benefit notifications
detail: Prints one notice when rested experience reaches the cap.

title: Rare alerts
detail: Announces a rare or rare-elite target once per session with its NPC ID and an optional sound.

title: XP-per-hour and level estimates
detail: Records experience gained and reports the hourly rate with /fs xp.

title: Equipment groups
detail: Named gear groups store item IDs; /fs gear add, remove, list and show manage them without touching items.

title: Equipment group bag markers
detail: Gold borders mark bag slots whose item belongs to the selected gear group and refresh on bag changes.

title: Fishing equipment restoration
detail: Remembers the weapons worn before a fishing pole and restores them with /fs fish restore.

title: Double-click fishing
detail: /fs fish casts Fishing and ignores a second cast within one second so a double click cannot cancel the cast.

title: Fishing lure selection
detail: Saved lure item IDs are applied with /fs lure <name> from the bags; nothing is bought.

title: Missing lure reminder
detail: When no aura with Lure in its name is active, /fs fish prints a reminder; the name check is English-only.

title: Unlearned spellbook entries
detail: /fs trainer missing lists trainer services you can still learn, based on the open trainer window.

title: Class trainer bulk purchase
detail: /fs train learns every available service inside a gold cap and reports the total spent.

title: Spell rank upgrades
detail: /fs trainer ranks shows available services whose rank text is above Rank 1.

title: Food and drink macro
detail: /fs eat and /fs drink use the first matching food or drink from the bags outside combat.

title: Pet food highlights
detail: /fs petfood lists consumables that look like pet food; nothing is fed automatically.

title: Mana regeneration timing
detail: /fs regen reports mana, its percentage, time since mana was spent and whether the five-second rule is running.

title: Reagent bag integration
detail: One chosen bag (0-4) is excluded from the automatic selling rules so reagents are never vendored.

title: Bag filters
detail: The bag search accepts #quest, #gear, #reagent, #consumable, #junk and #rare filters combined with text.

title: Search by item properties
detail: Searches bag item names with /fs bag <text> and reports bag and slot for each match.

title: Account gold tracker
detail: Records gold per character while enabled and reports the list and total through /fs gold. It never moves, mails or trades gold.

title: Minimap button collection
detail: /fs minimap collect hides addon minimap buttons and restore shows them again; addons keep running.

title: Minimap shape and sizing
detail: Minimap scale and the round or square mask, both independent. Size covers the frame and buttons, shape swaps only the mask texture.

title: Micro menu visibility
detail: Hides the micro menu while shortcuts and slash commands keep working.

title: Action bar mouseover visibility
detail: Dims the main action bar until it is hovered, with an adjustable idle opacity.

title: Action button range coloring
detail: Out-of-range actions get a red tint and, optionally, unusable ones a blue tint, refreshed on a timer the user controls.

title: Action bar text customization
detail: /fs bartext hotkeys|macros|show hides or restores keybind letters and macro names.

title: Cursor ring
detail: A configurable ring texture follows the mouse and never blocks clicks.

title: Cursor trail
detail: A short fading dot trail follows the mouse and is removed when the feature is turned off.

title: Spell damage-per-second tooltips
detail: Adds damage per second for the spell's cast cycle to spell tooltips, calculated from the client's own tooltip damage and cast time.

title: Spell damage-per-minute tooltips
detail: Adds damage per minute at the same cast cycle so a slow and a fast nuke can be compared directly.

title: Damage-per-mana tooltips
detail: Adds total damage divided by the spell's power cost using C_Spell.GetSpellPowerCost.

title: Mana cost percentage
detail: Adds the power cost as a percentage of the player's maximum mana.

title: Damage-over-time contribution setting
detail: For damage over time spells, prints the tick count and the share of damage that comes from ticks.

title: Spell calculation formatting and preview
detail: /fs spellcalc <min> <max> <cast> [mana] [cooldown] [duration] runs the same calculation as the tooltip outside a fight and validates every number.

title: Spell calculation localization
detail: Labels resolve through the client locale with an English fallback; /fs spelllabels reports the locale in use and any missing labels. Only English is shipped.

title: Ground hazard audio warnings
detail: Plays a sound and prints one line when a spell on the player-maintained hazard list starts affecting you; the list starts empty.

title: Friendly-fire warnings
detail: Friendly-fire detection needs the combat log, which Forever restricts (combat log entries arrive as secret tables) and no replacement API reports who an area spell hit. Shipping a guess would be worse than no warning, so this stays out.

title: Failure warnings
detail: Plays a sound and repeats the client's own error text when an action fails, based on UI_ERROR_MESSAGE keywords.

title: Hazard data maintenance
detail: The hazard list is maintained with /fs hazard add, remove, list, import, export and check; import and export are plain comma separated spell IDs.

title: Alert sound categories and volume
detail: Chooses one of three built-in sounds per warning category and can silence all of them. This client exposes no per-sound volume to addons, so categories offer different sounds instead of a slider (documented in the option text).

title: Alert exemptions
detail: /fs hazard exempt <id> and /fs hazard allow <id> keep one spell from warning even while it stays on the hazard list.

title: Allowed aura-sound API integration
detail: Registers tracked hazards through C_UnitAuras.AddAuraSound and removes them with RemoveAuraSound, falling back to ForeverSuite's own aura watcher when the API is missing.

title: Environmental danger warnings
detail: Warns once when the fatigue or breath mirror timer falls below a chosen percentage of its maximum; only mirror timer events are read, never health.

title: Custom loot window
detail: A compact loot list with quality colours and click-to-loot lines; the client window can stay or be hidden.

title: Loot notifications
detail: Prints what you receive, who looted it and the item level when the client reports it.

title: Backpack tracked-item bar
detail: A small bar with the counts of the items you track, updated with the bags.

title: Merchant multi-currency display
detail: /fs cost <index> prints every alternative currency cost of a merchant item.

title: Instance difficulty selector
detail: /fs difficulty [dungeon|raid] [n] reads and sets the instance difficulty through the client's own API.

title: Expansion activity summary
detail: /fs activity summarises the group finder, quest log and lockout signals the client exposes.

title: Drawer macros and flyouts
detail: Up to eight named macros in a movable drawer, run by clicking; /fs drawer manages the list.

title: Target cast tooltip information
detail: Unit tooltips state what the target is casting and how long is left, and hide the line when the client marks the cast secret.

title: Target ability reference
detail: /fs tcast prints the spell your target is casting with its ID, cost and description.

title: Talking head replacement
detail: Replaces the talking head popup with a chat line and hides the frame while it is active.

title: Boss banner controls
detail: Hides the large boss encounter banner. Encounter mechanics and warnings are not changed.

title: Event toast controls
detail: /fs toast removes the current event toast; an option clears toasts as they arrive.

title: Sound category muting
detail: /fs mute <master|music|ambience|dialog|sfx> stores the previous volume and restores exactly that value.

title: Music and movie browser
detail: /fs music plays a sound ID, saves favourites and stops playback. The beta client exposes no movie playback API.

title: Player and target frames
detail: Scales the player and target frames and hides their 3D portraits; health and combat behaviour stay with the client.

title: Party and raid frames
detail: Scales the compact party and raid frames and can set the client's compact layout CVar.

title: Resource bars
detail: A text readout of power type, value and percentage that says so when the client marks power secret.

title: Absorb displays where permitted
detail: Total damage and healing absorb as a text line, hidden or marked when the client makes the values secret.

title: Cooldown panels
detail: A panel listing the spells you track with remaining time or ready state.

title: Cooldown pulse notifications
detail: Prints and optionally plays a sound when a tracked spell becomes ready.

title: Swing display integration
detail: Swing timer fed by PLAYER_SWING with main hand, off hand and ranged labels.

title: Threat-independent nameplate enhancements
detail: Draws the target's cast on its nameplate and clears it when the cast stops, fails or is interrupted.

title: Native damage meter integration
detail: /fs meter lists the client's own combat sessions; ForeverSuite draws no meter of its own.

title: Ready-check reminders
detail: Announces a ready check in chat and can answer it for you when every option is allowed.

title: Group role and leader indicators
detail: Group role and leader markers in group output, resolved through one label helper.

title: Dungeon group tools when supported
detail: /fs group prints members, roles, leader and assistant flags plus the current instance.

title: Gameplay system availability audit
detail: /fs audit lists which gameplay systems this client actually exposes.

title: Searchable advanced CVar browser
detail: Search a curated CVar list with /fs cvar list <text>, and read current value, default, meaning and range with /fs cvar <name>.

title: Per-CVar help and defaults
detail: Every browser entry carries a plain-language help line, its default and its valid range.

title: CVar type/range validation
detail: Booleans accept only on/off and numbers must be finite and inside the documented range before the value is written.

title: CVar change history
detail: The last 20 browser changes are stored with before and after values and shown by /fs cvar history.

title: Global profiles
detail: Named profiles store every switch and option and switch with /fs profile.

title: Per-character profiles
detail: A character scope remembers which profile each character used and restores it at login.

title: Import/export profiles
detail: Export writes a validated FS1 string into the copy box; import accepts it and drops anything unknown.

title: Input validation on imported settings
detail: Import validates feature IDs, option keys and values against the live registry before saving the profile.

title: Beta-to-launch profile migration
status: implemented-preview via profile export/import; in-game validation pending
detail: Export the profile string from the beta client, then import it in the launch client with /fs profile import. Unknown or unavailable features are dropped instead of applied.

title: Per-feature ownership adapters
detail: Applying a profile revalidates and refreshes every affected feature through the shared registry instead of writing raw data.

title: Reference addon setting migration
detail: /fs migrate legacy moves flat settings from older builds; /fs migrate refs lists overlapping loaded addons without reading their saved variables.

title: Localization
detail: All user-facing strings resolve through one table with an English fallback; /fs locale reports coverage.

title: Gamepad settings navigation
detail: Arrow keys move the settings highlight and Enter toggles it, so a controller that sends keys can drive the window.

title: UI scaling and accessibility
detail: Scales only the ForeverSuite settings, details, options and report windows.

title: Per-module performance measurements
detail: Every refresh records total time and the slowest feature enable; /fs report prints both.

title: Full source-option coverage reconciliation
detail: tools/coverage.py loads the addon, compares every registered feature with the backlog and fails when either side drifts.
implementation: tools/coverage.py loads the addon, compares every registered feature with the backlog and fails when either side drifts.

title: License and asset provenance audit
detail: tools/provenance.py checks the SPDX header on every source file and rejects binary assets in the addon tree.
implementation: tools/provenance.py checks the SPDX header on every source file and rejects binary assets in the addon tree.

title: Launch-client regression suite
detail: tools/release_check.py runs the load check, the behavioural suite, the backlog audit, the provenance audit and the TOC check in one command.
implementation: tools/release_check.py runs the load check, the behavioural suite, the backlog audit, the provenance audit and the TOC check in one command.

title: Vendor sell price in tooltips
detail: Shows the price a vendor pays for the hovered item, outside combat.

title: Tooltip scale
detail: Scales game, item, shopping and friend tooltips by a percentage option.

title: Hide action bar gryphons
detail: Hides the decorative gryphon end caps beside the main action bar.

title: Hide zone name text
detail: Hides the large zone name shown after loading or crossing a zone boundary.

title: Hide the objective tracker
detail: Hides the on-screen quest objective list. Quests are still tracked and completed.

title: Chat timestamps
detail: Adds a local time stamp in front of each chat message.

title: Rotate the minimap
detail: Turns the minimap with the character facing direction instead of north up.

title: Floating combat text toggles
detail: Hides floating damage and healing numbers independently.

title: Maximum camera zoom distance
detail: Sets the camera distance multiplier between 1 and 4.

title: Free bag slots on the backpack
detail: Shows the number of empty carried bag slots on the backpack button.

title: Nameplate maximum distance
detail: Sets how far away nameplates remain visible, in yards.

title: Automatic reputation tracking
detail: Watches the faction whose reputation changes so its bar updates without manual selection.

title: Death screen effect toggle
detail: Disables the desaturated death overlay while leaving the release dialog intact.

title: Nameplate scale
detail: Scales nameplates by a percentage option from 50 to 200 percent. The client may clamp extreme values.

title: Hide the minimap clock
detail: Hides the clock button beside the minimap without changing game time or chat timestamps.

title: Hide the minimap zone label
detail: Hides the zone name text on the minimap; zone-change text and minimap tracking are unchanged.

title: Whisper sound alert
detail: Plays the client tell sound for incoming whispers, with an option to mute it during combat.

title: Thousands separators
detail: Groups long numbers with a separator for readability.

title: New spells on the action bar
detail: Lets the client place newly learned spells on the first free action bar slot.

title: Always show friendly nameplates
detail: Keeps friendly player nameplates visible outside combat.

title: Spell reference command
detail: /fs ability <id> prints name, cast time, cost and description for a spell ID.

title: All auras on the target
detail: Shows every aura the client exposes on the target, not only debuffs.

title: Always show action bars
detail: Keeps the action bars visible instead of fading them in combat or on mouse-out.

title: Automatic quest progress updates
detail: Refreshes the quest log and tracker when progress events arrive.

title: Track accepted quests automatically
detail: Adds newly accepted quests to the objective tracker.

title: Automatic self-cast
detail: Sets the client's auto self-cast CVar and restores the previous value.

title: Aura duration text
detail: Prints the remaining duration of your auras in the tooltip and in a short chat report.

title: Chat bubbles above players
detail: Shows or hides the client's chat bubbles with a saved preference.

title: Numeric cooldown countdowns
detail: Switches the client's numeric cooldown text on and off.

title: Emphasize your own spell effects
detail: Raises the visibility of your own spell effects through the client CVars.

title: Hide healing numbers
detail: Hides healing floating combat text independently of damage numbers.

title: Lock action bars
detail: Sets the client's action bar lock CVar and restores it when disabled.

title: Quest difficulty on the world map
detail: Adds the quest level and difficulty band to quest tooltips on the map.

title: Party chat bubbles
detail: Shows party and raid chat bubbles independently of the general bubble setting.

title: Quest tracking tooltips
detail: Adds quest title, level and state to unit and item tooltips where the client reports them.

title: Item levels on loot rolls
detail: Adds the item level to need/greed roll frames without touching the roll buttons.

title: Prevent right-click auto-cast toggling
detail: Blocks the right-click auto-cast toggle on action buttons while the feature is on.

title: Target cast bar
detail: A movable cast bar for your target, fed by the client's unit cast events.
